spine: 1. 自動化 a11y 檢查只驗 alt 屬性存不存在，不驗描述是否對得上圖片，所以 alt="IMG_2847.png" 能通過檢查。
2. WebAIM 2026 Million：16.2% 圖片完全沒 alt，另外 10.8% 有 alt 但描述不足（檔名／泛稱／抄鄰居），合計超過四分之一。
3. GitHub Accessibility Scanner 的 alt text plugin 用五條 deterministic 規則：缺失／空白、檔名當 alt、placeholder 文字、泛稱詞、相鄰重複——全部不需要看圖，只需要字串比對。
4. 這五條規則能證明字串錯，卻不能證明字串對——通順但描述錯誤的 alt 文字規則抓不到，這是自動檢查的結構性天花板。
5. 相鄰重複規則原本按文件順序判斷，結果 header 和 footer 的 GitHub logo 被誤判成一組，真正該抓的（五顆星圖示都寫 alt="3/5 stars"）才是問題——改用版面 bounding box 距離判斷後修正。
6. 唯一能碰語意的機制是 opt-in 的視覺模型規則：把圖片加上最近標題、頁面標題、figcaption、周邊文字一起送進 GitHub Models，用四步決策（decorative → redundant → functional → informative）命中就停，並加上反吹毛求疵規則防止模型無止盡建議「這可以更好」。
7. 這條規則預設關閉，需要手動開 token，而且會產生 false positive——GitHub 自己的結論是「passing isn't conformance，automated checks are a floor」，真正的驗收是找會用輔助科技的人來測。

perspective.mechanism: GitHub 的 alt text plugin 用五條字串層級的 deterministic 規則抓「明顯沒寫好」的 alt，外加一條 opt-in、送圖進視覺模型、用四步決策程序判斷語意對不對的規則。
perspective.tradeoff: deterministic 規則零誤判但天花板低——只能抓語法層級的壞；視覺模型規則能碰語意但會有 false positive，所以只能是 opt-in、需要手動開 token，而不是預設規則。
perspective.reader_use: 如果團隊也在用自動化 a11y 掃描，可以直接把這個 repo 的 alt-text plugin 接進 CI，但要清楚：通過不等於做對，綠燈只代表五條字串規則沒抓到明顯錯誤，還是要找真正用輔助科技的人測。

notes.quote: More than one in four images on the web's most popular home pages have alt text that's missing, vague, or copied from adjacent images.
notes.interpretation: 全文的核心統計主張，量化「看似過關，其實不到位」的落差有多大。

notes.quote: That's from WebAIM's 2026 WebAIM Million report, which found that alt text...was missing on 16.2% of images across the top million home pages.
notes.interpretation: 16.2% 是「完全沒 alt」，屬於自動檢查的存在性規則能直接抓到的部分。

notes.quote: Among the images that did have alt text, another 10.8% provided an undescriptive attribute, such as alt="image", a raw filename, or a description duplicated from a neighbor.
notes.interpretation: 10.8% 是本文真正要處理的族群——alt 有寫，但寫得沒意義，這正是自動檢查會誤判為通過的一塊。

notes.quote: The attribute is absent (not empty) or whitespace-only. The alt is a filename, such as hero.png, IMG_2847.jpg. The alt is a placeholder somebody meant to replace, such as TODO, tbd. The alt is one generic word naming the medium instead of the content, such as image, logo, chart. The same alt repeats across adjacent images.
notes.interpretation: 外掛的五條 deterministic 規則的完整定義，全部靠字串比對，不用看圖或呼叫模型。

notes.quote: The prompt walks four ordered steps, stops at the first that matches, and emits that step's verdict: decorative, redundant with a caption, functional, or informative.
notes.interpretation: opt-in 視覺模型規則的核心決策邏輯——四步依序檢查，命中就停，不是四個獨立分類。

notes.quote: alt="IMG_2847.png"
notes.interpretation: 檔名當 alt 的具體例子，也是標題本身在講的那個案例。

notes.quote: Picture a row of five star-shaped icons that each say "3/5 stars". A screen reader user hears the same thing five times and learns nothing new from four of them.
notes.interpretation: 相鄰重複規則要抓的具體情境——同一段文字對五張不同圖都成立，讀者聽五次一樣的話。

notes.quote: For example, a footer 'GitHub' logo and a header 'GitHub' logo might sit next to each other in the extracted list but nowhere near each other on screen, so nobody experiences them as a group.
notes.interpretation: 用文件順序判斷相鄰會產生的具體誤判案例——兩個 logo 在 markup 裡相鄰，畫面上卻一個在最上一個在最下。

notes.quote: What matters is where images land on screen, not where they sit in the markup.
notes.interpretation: 外掛改用 bounding box 版面距離而非 DOM 順序的設計原則。

notes.quote: The rule is off by default. It won't run unless you deliberately enable it in your plugin configuration, and it needs a token with access to GitHub Models.
notes.interpretation: 視覺模型規則是 opt-in，需要手動設定 token 才會跑，預設關閉。

notes.quote: Image URLs and link hrefs often carry signed CDN tokens or session identifiers, so query and fragment are stripped from anything entering the model context or the rule's error logs.
notes.interpretation: 送進模型前有做隱私處理，去掉網址裡的 query 和 fragment。

notes.quote: Given perfectly good alt text, our first version of the checker would suggest different alt text, because 'could this be better?' is a question a language model always answers yes to.
notes.interpretation: 第一版做法失敗的具體經驗——不加防呆，模型永遠會挑剔，就算 alt 已經很好。

notes.quote: Three changes fixed it: A decision procedure instead of an instruction... Explicit anti-nitpick rules... Trust the author's framing.
notes.interpretation: 三個修正手段，對應四步決策程序、明確的反吹毛求疵規則，以及相信作者原本的用意。

notes.quote: Treat a short alt as correct when the surrounding prose already analyzes the image.
notes.interpretation: 反吹毛求疵規則的具體例子——周邊文字已經在講這張圖時，alt 短一點也算對。

notes.quote: We extract page context alongside each image: the nearest heading, the page title, any <figcaption>, whether the image sits inside a link or button, and up to 600 characters of nearby prose.
notes.interpretation: 送進視覺模型的 context 包含哪些欄位，量化到「附近 600 字」的上限。

notes.quote: The deterministic rules are literal. They catch alt text that's obviously unwritten, not alt text that's fluent and wrong.
notes.interpretation: 直接點名五條規則的天花板——只抓明顯沒寫，抓不到寫得通順但內容錯的情況。

notes.quote: The model-backed rule produces false positives. Every finding is a prompt for human attention, not a verdict.
notes.interpretation: 視覺模型規則本身也不是仲裁者，只是提示人去看。

notes.quote: That rule re-fetches images outside the browser session, so anything behind authentication can fail to load.
notes.interpretation: 視覺模型規則的已知限制——需要重新抓圖，擋在登入後面的圖可能抓不到。

notes.quote: We only check HTML tags. SVG, role="img" containers, CSS backgrounds, and canvas aren't covered yet.
notes.interpretation: 外掛目前的涵蓋範圍限制，只管 img 標籤。

notes.quote: a quality-oriented rule with false positives is a rule teams switch off
notes.interpretation: 為什麼「用模型抓語意」不能做成預設規則的設計理由——誤判太多，團隊乾脆關掉。

notes.quote: Passing isn't conformance. Automated checks are a floor. Testing with people who use assistive tech is the goal.
notes.interpretation: 全文的收束句——自動檢查是門檻不是終點，真正的驗收是找會用輔助科技的人來測。

notes.quote: Try the alt-text plugin in your accessibility scanning workflow
notes.interpretation: 外掛是公開釋出的 github/accessibility-scanner-alt-text-plugin，任何團隊都能直接使用，不是內部工具。

notes.quote: August 24, 2026
notes.interpretation: 文章發布日期為 2026 年 8 月 24 日，作者具名為 Taarik Ashenafi 與 Keenan Zhou，用於歸屬與時間戳。

notes.quote: We record that an image is inside a link, not that it is the link.
notes.interpretation: functional 這一步的已知限制——規則記錄的是圖片被放在連結或按鈕裡面這件事，不代表圖片本身就是那個連結或按鈕。
